article.headline: Bayern München 6-0 Borussia Dortmund: Robert Lewandowski hat-trick
article.dek: Bundesliga 2017/18, Matchday 28, 31 March 2018, Allianz Arena. Half-time 5-0.

sections.heading: Result
paragraphs: Bayern München beat Borussia Dortmund 6-0 in Bundesliga Matchday 28 at Allianz Arena, having led 5-0 at half-time.

sections.heading: How the goals came
paragraphs: 5' Robert Lewandowski, set up by Thomas Müller (Bayern München, 1-0); 14' James Rodríguez, set up by David Alaba (Bayern München, 2-0); 23' Thomas Müller, set up by James Rodríguez (Bayern München, 3-0); 44' Robert Lewandowski (Bayern München, 4-0); 45+1' Franck Ribéry, set up by James Rodríguez (Bayern München, 5-0); 87' Robert Lewandowski, set up by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern München, 6-0).

sections.heading: Shot profile
paragraphs: Bayern München had 15 shots, 8 on target; Borussia Dortmund had 9, 2 on target.
Bayern München took 12 of their shots inside the penalty area at an average distance of 15 m from goal; Borussia Dortmund took 3 inside the area at 18.3 m.

sections.heading: Territory and control
paragraphs: Bayern München completed 632 of 717 passes (88.1%) against Borussia Dortmund's 398 of 472 (84.3%), a 61.4% share of the match's completed passes.
59.9% of on-ball events in either attacking third belonged to Bayern München.
Duels: Bayern München won 58 of 151, Borussia Dortmund 57 of 151. Corners 2-1; fouls 6-7.

sections.heading: Key performers
paragraphs: Robert Lewandowski (Bayern München): 3 goals and 4 shots on target. James Rodríguez (Bayern München): 1 goal, 2 assists and 1 shot on target. Thomas Müller (Bayern München): 1 goal, 1 assist and 1 shot on target. Franck Ribéry (Bayern München): 1 goal and 1 shot on target.

sections.heading: Table impact and form
paragraphs: Bayern München stayed 1st on 69 points after 28 matches.
Bayern München's previous 5 league results: L W W D W.
Borussia Dortmund stayed 3rd on 48 points after 28 matches.
Borussia Dortmund's previous 5 league results: W W D D W.
